let b := Sup s
use b
· intro x
  intro hxs
  have hsup : x ≤ b := le_Sup hxs
  have hne : x ≠ b := by contraposition (λ h : x = b, hsup.symm.trans h ▸ hsup)
  exact lt_of_le_not_ge hsup hne
· intro y
  intro hyt
  have hinf : b ≤ y := le_Sup_iff.2 (λ z, z ∈ s → z ≤ y) (λ z hz, H z hz y hyt)
  have hne : b ≠ y := by contraposition (λ h : b = y, hinf.symm.trans h ▸ hinf)
  exact lt_of_le_not_ge hinf hne
